verses.text: Yahweh, how my adversaries have increased! Many are those who rise up against me.
lines: Yahweh, how my adversaries have increased!
Many are those who rise up against me.

verses.text: Many there are who say of my soul, “There is no help for him in God.”
lines: Many there are who say of my soul,
“There is no help for him in God.”

verses.text: But you, Yahweh, are a shield around me, my glory, and the one who lifts up my head.
lines: But you, Yahweh, are a shield around me,
my glory, and the one who lifts up my head.

verses.text: I cry to Yahweh with my voice, and he answers me out of his holy hill.
lines: I cry to Yahweh with my voice,
and he answers me out of his holy hill.

verses.text: I laid myself down and slept. I awakened; for Yahweh sustains me.
lines: I laid myself down and slept.
I awakened; for Yahweh sustains me.

verses.text: I will not be afraid of tens of thousands of people who have set themselves against me on every side.
lines: I will not be afraid of tens of thousands of people
who have set themselves against me on every side.

verses.text: Arise, Yahweh! Save me, my God! For you have struck all of my enemies on the cheek bone. You have broken the teeth of the wicked.
lines: For you have struck all of my enemies on the cheek bone.
You have broken the teeth of the wicked.

verses.text: Salvation belongs to Yahweh. May your blessing be on your people.
lines: May your blessing be on your people.
